battle.name: 同治新疆回亂
battle.brief: 一八六二年五月，陝西渭南、大荔一帶回民起義，戰火經陝東、河州、肅州燒到天山南北，演成十五年裡清廷、回軍、浩罕與阿古柏四方角力的西北大戰。線膛砲在陝甘攻堅中只是配合的舊器械，到左宗棠西征才升格為封鎖城垣的骨幹，同時把前裝砲射速低、彈藥沉重的弱點暴露得一清二楚。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的一方是大清帝國。西北戰區由陝甘總督左宗棠、陝西巡撫劉蓉等節制，兵源以楚軍、湘軍為主，輔以淮軍洋槍隊、綠營、八旗馬隊與甘肅團練，糧餉軍械則仰賴陝西、河南、山西的協濟與轉運。另一方是關中與河西的回民起義聯軍：一八五六年間河州回民起義是它的先聲，同治元年陝西大荔、華州一帶舉事之後，陝東、關中、平涼、慶陽、河州、肅州相繼響應，形成以回民武裝為骨幹、漢族叛軍與太平軍、捻軍外線策應為附的鬆散聯盟，內部按地域與首領分股，沒有統一指揮。浩罕汗國以布魯特河為界遙遙介入，一八六二年扶植玉素甫汗攻入喀什噶爾，一八六四年被阿古柏逐出；阿古柏自建政權於喀什噶爾與和闐，同英俄兩方都有往來。俄羅斯帝國趁同治年間的勘界與阿古柏攻取伊犁之機，於一八七一年派兵佔領伊犁全境；大英帝國以駐清公使威妥瑪赴喀什談判通商，並默許英屬印度向喀什方向走私軍火。太平天國的西征大軍與北方捻軍在同治初年牽制了大量清軍，是這場亂局裡不能忽略的第三股力量。
countriesEn: One side was the Qing Empire. The northwestern theatre was directed by such officials as Zuo Zongtang, Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, and Liu Rong, Governor of Shaanxi; the troops came mainly from the Chu and Hunan armies, supported by the foreign-drilled musketeers of the Huai Army, the Green Standard, Banner cavalry and local militia in Gansu, while pay, provisions and weapons depended on the neighbouring provinces of Shaanxi, Henan and Shanxi for requisition and transport. The other side was the insurgent coalition of the Hui communities of Guanzhong and the Hexi corridor. The Hui rising at Hezhou in 1856 was its prelude; after the outbreak in the Dali and Huazhou districts of Shaanxi in the first year of Tongzhi, eastern Shaanxi, Guanzhong, Pingliang, Qingyang, Hezhou and Suzhou answered in turn, forming a loose alliance whose backbone was the Hui armed bands, with Han deserters and the outer-strategy support of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and the Nian army attached to it. That coalition had no central command; it split by locality and by its various leaders. The Kokand Khanate intervened at a distance from beyond the Bulat River, backing Yusuf Beg's entry into Kashgar in 1862 and being driven out by Yaqub in 1864. Yaqub then built a state of his own at Kashgar and Yarkand, and dealt with both Britain and Russia. The Russian Empire took advantage of the border demarcation of the Tongzhi years and of Yaqub's seizure of Ili, and in 1871 sent troops to occupy the whole of Ili. Great Britain, through its minister to the Qing court, Thomas Wade, negotiated a commercial agreement with Yaqub at Kashgar and tacitly allowed British India to smuggle arms in the direction of Kashgar. The Taiping expedition in the west and the Nian army in the north had tied down large Qing armies in the early Tongzhi years, and they form the third force that cannot be ignored in this turmoil.
people: 回軍方面的關鍵人物，陝西起義初期是大荔、華州一帶的馬萬虎，與馬明遠等同族首領各領一部；河西方面以臨夏（河州）的馬化龍居首，他在一八六二年被清廷賞穿黃馬甲、記名總兵，一度以受撫換取招撫回眾，同治九年清軍攻破蘇家營大營、回軍崩潰時，馬化龍自盡，部眾或降或散，馬占鰲同年死於內部爭權，餘部隨之瓦解。清方主持者是左宗棠，他以在前方辦軍需、籌運糧草的實績著稱，同治六年署陝甘總督，光緒元年間主持西征；此前在陝西主持軍務的巡撫劉蓉與左宗棠在戰略與用人上屢有衝突，終至去職，湘軍老將多隆阿在攻蒲城時受傷病故，鮑超率楚軍轉戰陝東與河西，金順主持蘇家營攻堅。收復新疆期間，前線由劉錦棠統率，後方糧臺由楊昌濬辦理。淮軍洋槍隊與戈登的常勝軍在上海的戰績，讓清廷深信洋槍洋砲的價值；英國公使威妥瑪一八七三年赴喀什噶爾同阿古柏議定通商，後來赴莫斯科收回伊犁的則是曾紀澤。
peopleEn: On the insurgent side the key figures were, at the start of the Shaanxi rising, Ma Wanhu of the Dali and Huazhou district and other clan leaders such as Ma Mingyuan, each commanding a separate band; on the Hexi side the leading man was Ma Hualong of Linxia, that is Hezhou, who in 1862 was honoured by the Qing court with the yellow jacket and a nominal brigadier general rank, and who for a time bought the submission of the Hui masses by accepting pardon. When the Qing army broke into the great camp at Sujiaying in the ninth year of Tongzhi and the insurgent army collapsed, Ma Hualong killed himself, his followers surrendering or scattering, while Ma Zhan'ao died in the same year in an internal struggle for power and the remainder broke up with him. On the Qing side the man in charge was Zuo Zongtang, known for his practical work at the front in organising the commissariat and hauling grain. He took acting charge of the Shaanxi-Gansu military administration in the sixth year of Tongzhi and led the western expedition from the first year of Guangxu. Before him the Governor of Shaanxi, Liu Rong, clashed repeatedly with Zuo over strategy and appointments until he was dismissed; the old Hunan commander Duolong'a was wounded at the attack on Pucheng and died of his wounds, Bao Chao led Chu troops through eastern Shaanxi and Hexi, and Jin Shun directed the assault on Sujiaying. During the reconquest of Xinjiang the front was commanded by Liu Jintang while the granary and transport lines were handled by Yang Changjun. The performance of the Huai Army's foreign-drilled musketeers and of Gordon's Ever Victorious Army at Shanghai convinced the Qing court of the value of foreign arms, and the British minister Thomas Wade went to Kashgar in 1873 to settle a commercial agreement with Yaqub; the man who later went to Moscow to recover Ili was Zeng Jize.
kits: 卡面這件線膛砲是一八五〇年代德國式的線膛野戰砲：身管內壁旋有膛線，發射時藥筒自後膛裝入，藥量不變而彈丸在膛線中被強行旋轉，出膛後仍貼著軸線飛行，因此射程與精度都遠勝於清軍原有的舊式架式銅砲，也勝過回軍繳獲的太平軍舊炮。技術上它是前裝，射前要清膛、量藥、塞彈、搗桿，一門炮每分鐘不過十數發，且膛線一旦磨損或膛內積炭就精度大跌，所以它更適合作為固定陣地的支援火力，而不是靠人命換射速的野戰消耗品。戰場上實際出現的裝備層次極雜：陝甘階段有漢軍的抬槍與舊式銅砲，也有繳自太平軍和綠營的架式炮；清廷在蘇州一帶接收大量洋槍洋砲之後，淮軍洋槍隊與常勝軍把前膛線膛步槍帶入西北；到同治末年，左宗棠自上海洋行及天津機器局購置德國克虜廠的十二磅線膛野戰砲一批，並在蘭州、哈密設修械所與火藥廠，配套子母彈與藥包，遠程砲用來封鎖城牆，步隊再以地道爆破破城；回軍與阿古柏軍則靠繳獲的俄製步槍與外購武器，居高臨下以騎兵游擊，衝擊清軍的糧道與哨所。
kitsEn: The piece on the card is a German-pattern rifled muzzle-loading field gun of the 1850s. Its barrel is rifled on the inside; the cartridge is loaded from the breech end, and with the same charge the shot is forced to spin inside the rifling and still hugs the axis after leaving the muzzle, so both range and accuracy greatly exceed the old smooth-bore bronze guns of the Qing army and the captured Taiping pieces used by the insurgents. Technically it is a muzzle-loader: before every round the barrel must be cleaned, the charge measured, the cartridge rammed and the priming tamped, and a gun could fire only a dozen or so rounds a minute. Once the rifling is worn or fouled with soot the accuracy falls away, which makes the piece far better suited to fixed positions as supporting fire than to a mobile fight decided by rate of fire. The equipment actually seen on the battlefield was far more mixed. In the Shaanxi-Gansu phase there were Han swivel guns and old bronze pieces, together with howitzers and guns captured from the Taiping and the Green Standard; after the Qing court took in large quantities of foreign arms and guns at Suzhou, the foreign-drilled musketeers of the Huai Army and of the Ever Victorious Army carried muzzle-loading rifled rifles into the northwest. By the end of the Tongzhi reign Zuo Zongtang bought a batch of twelve-pounder rifled field guns of the German Krupp works through the foreign firms in Shanghai and from the Tianjin Arsenal, and set up repair shops and a gunpowder manufactory at Lanzhou and Hami, with canister and loose ammunition to match. The long-range guns were used to lock down the city walls, and the infantry then broke the walls by mining and blasting. The insurgents and Yaqub's men, for their part, relied on captured Russian rifles and purchased weapons, and from high ground they used cavalry raids to harass the Qing grain convoys and outposts.
tactics: 整場戰爭大致分三個戰術階段。陝甘階段是典型的據點攻守：回軍依城塬、堡寨與山寨自守，騎兵流動出擊、襲擾糧道，再退回塬上以砲與銃固守；清軍依賴湘楚軍的營壘與封鎖線，一處一處合圍，先以冷砲、挖壕、填壕逼近，再以突擊破堡，因此戰線推得極慢。蘇家營一役最能說明這種打法：清軍圍而不急攻，築壘挖壕、以火藥炸開塹牆，最後以連續突擊攻入大營。第二階段是左宗棠的西征，其核心是先糧後兵：先設糧臺、轉運站與驛站網，把數千頭駱駝與數千輛車的糧秣從內地經嘉峪關外的肅州一路送到哈密，再以哈密為後方基地向北推進，分北、中、南三路，盆地之間的縱深使得任何一路受阻都不致全軍停滯。前線的打法是砲兵封鎖堡壘、步隊結陣、輔以工兵爆破，配合騎兵巡邏護路；阿古柏的騎兵屢次襲擊糧隊，清軍便以環營車陣與騎兵反擊解決。作戰季節性明顯，冬季酷寒、夏季酷熱，糧秣與草料消耗巨大，多在春、秋兩季推進。
tacticsEn: The war fell roughly into three tactical phases. The Shaanxi-Gansu phase was a typical contest of strongpoints: the insurgents held fortified towns, stockades and hill forts, rode out with cavalry to strike and to harass the supply roads, then withdrew to the plateau positions to hold with guns and muskets. The Qing army, relying on the entrenchments and cordon lines of the Hunan and Chu troops, had to invest position by position, first bringing up guns, digging and filling trenches to close in, then storming the stockade, so that the front advanced extremely slowly. The action at Sujiaying illustrates the method best: the Qing army encircled without hurrying the assault, built redoubts, dug trenches, blew the parapet open with powder and then entered the great camp by successive assaults. The second phase was Zuo Zongtang's western expedition, whose core was to move the grain before the troops: first to establish a granary office, relay stations and a courier network, driving several thousand camels and several thousand carts of provisions from the interior through Suzhou outside Jiayuguan to Hami, and only then to use Hami as a rear base and push north in three columns, north, centre and south, so that the depth between basins meant no single blocked column could stop the whole army. On the front line the pattern was artillery locking down the forts, infantry closing in in formation, engineers assisting with mining and blasting, and cavalry patrolling the roads; Yaqub's horsemen repeatedly attacked the convoys, and the Qing answered with wagon laager and counter-raiding cavalry. The fighting was sharply seasonal, with bitter cold in winter and oppressive heat in summer, fodder and grain consuming enormously, and the advance was made mainly in spring and autumn.
data: 時間上這場戰爭自一八六二年起，到一八七七年阿古柏政權覆亡為止，前後十五年，若連同一八八〇至一八八一年收回伊犁的外交尾聲則更長。地理跨度極大，陝西渭南到甘肅酒泉約一千數百里，再由哈密向北直抵烏魯木齊約數百里，戰場橫跨塔里木盆地南北。兵力方面，清軍在陝甘以湘軍、楚軍為主力，出關時集中兵力以數萬計；回軍與阿古柏軍的馬隊規模相當，且能在多個戰區分頭作戰。線膛砲方面，左宗棠自上海洋行購置的德國克虜廠十二磅野戰砲數量以百門計，分撥各營；此類前裝線膛野戰砲的有效射程在數千公尺，遠超清軍原有舊砲，對固定堡壘具壓倒性優勢，但射速只有每分鐘十數發，且每發都需前裝藥包與擦膛，彈藥供應才是它最大的限制。物資方面，出征的糧秣靠數千頭駱駝自內地運至哈密，軍需、糧秣與轉運的開支以數百萬兩計；攻達坂城前後，清軍屢有繳獲外製步槍以千計的記錄，足以說明外來軍火在這條戰線上的密度。
dataEn: In time, the war ran from 1862 to the fall of Yaqub's regime in 1877, fifteen years in all, and longer still if the diplomatic aftermath that recovered Ili between 1880 and 1881 is counted. The geographical spread was enormous: some one to two thousand li from Weinan in Shaanxi to Suzhou in Gansu, then a further several hundred li from Hami north to Urumqi, with the battlefield crossing the Tarim basin from north to south. In men, the Qing army in Shaanxi and Gansu was formed chiefly of the Hunan and Chu troops, and concentrated for the advance beyond the frontier in numbers running into the tens of thousands; the cavalry of the insurgents and of Yaqub's forces were of comparable scale and could operate simultaneously in several theatres. As for the rifled guns, the twelve-pounder field pieces of the German Krupp works bought by Zuo Zongtang through the foreign firms in Shanghai were counted in hundreds and were distributed among the units; the effective range of such muzzle-loading rifled field guns lay in the thousands of metres, well beyond the old Qing pieces and overwhelmingly superior against fixed works, but the rate of fire was only a dozen or so rounds a minute, and every round demanded a loaded cartridge and a swabbed barrel, so ammunition supply was the real limit on the weapon. On the materiel side, the grain for the expedition was moved to Hami by several thousand camels out of the interior, and the commissariat, provisions and transport together cost in the several millions of taels; around the storming of Daban there are repeated records of thousands of foreign rifles captured, which shows how dense imported arms were on this front.
cause: 火種來自陝西關中的水。渭南、大荔、華州一帶回漢雜居，井渠灌溉、墳地界線、糧價與差役糾紛一向靠地方團練與族長調解，咸豐末年大旱與糧荒令積怨爆發，一八六二年五月回眾攻破團練堡寨、殺官抗稅，原本的地方水利糾紛迅速脫離原意，變成回民另立旗號、漢民結寨自保的團體對抗，一八六三年陝東、關中、平涼、慶陽相繼響應，戰火一年內由幾個縣蔓延到整個陝甘。外部條件同樣關鍵：太平天國西征大軍打到陝西，捻軍在中原轉戰，兩者都迫使清廷分兵，陝甘防務空虛；浩罕汗國為爭南疆商路與玉石生意，縱容並武裝玉素甫汗進攻喀什噶爾，把天山南北一併拖入割據爭鬥。各地回民一旦各自武裝，鎮壓便必須升級為跨省的區域戰爭，這才是同治新疆回亂真正的起因。
causeEn: The spark came from water in the Guanzhong plain of Shaanxi. Around Weinan, Dali and Huazhou the Hui and Han lived side by side, and disputes over well and channel irrigation, over burial-ground boundaries, over grain prices and over corvée labour had always been settled by local militia and clan elders. Drought and famine in the last years of Xianfeng made the accumulated grievances burst: in May 1862 the crowd broke into the militia stockades, killed officials and refused tax, and what had been a local quarrel over water quickly turned into an organised confrontation in which the Hui raised banners of their own while the Han fortified their villages. In 1863 eastern Shaanxi, Guanzhong, Pingliang and Qingyang answered in turn, and within a year the fighting spread from a few counties across all of Shaanxi and Gansu. The external conditions mattered just as much: the Taiping expedition pushed into Shaanxi and the Nian armies fought across the central plains, both forcing the court to divide its forces and leaving Shaanxi and Gansu thinly held, while the Kokand Khanate, competing for the trade routes and the jade of the southern frontier, armed and encouraged Yusuf Beg to attack Kashgar and dragged the whole Tian Shan region into a contest of rival principalities. Once the Hui communities in different localities armed themselves, suppression had to be upgraded into a war spanning several provinces, and that is the real origin of the Tongzhi Xinjiang revolt.
impact: 第一層後果是清朝對西北的重新編制：回亂平定後，陝甘總督與新疆的關係需要重新安排，光緒十年新疆建省，劉錦棠出任首任巡撫，行政與軍政合一，邊疆從軍府性質的羈縻轉為省制，這套制度一直延續到二十世紀。其次是邊界與外交的隱患：俄羅斯在同治年間趁勘界之機取得布魯特河以南廣大地區，一八七一年又以阿古柏進攻伊犁為由出兵佔領伊犁，直到一八八一年經曾紀澤在莫斯科交涉才得以收回，但俄方仍割去部分邊地，清廷亦付出一筆賠款，伊犁的歸屬從此成為往後數十年再起爭端的源頭；英俄在喀什噶爾的競爭也自此固定化，喀什一地同時面對兩方施壓。第三是軍事技術的更新：線膛砲與前膛線膛步槍在戰役中的表現，讓清廷看見洋槍洋砲的價值，江南製造局、天津機器局等新式兵工相繼開辦，砲兵在編制上重新取得位置。第四是西北社會的重組，戰後的招撫安置把大量流離人口移回河西與河套屯墾，族群分佈與地方秩序為之一變；太平天國與捻軍在此期間被清廷次第剿滅，也讓清廷把注意力重新收回國內。
impactEn: The first consequence was a thorough reorganisation of the Qing presence in the northwest. Once the revolt was settled, the relationship between the Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu and Xinjiang had to be rearranged; in the tenth year of Guangxu Xinjiang was made a province, Liu Jintang became its first governor, and administration and military command were fused, so that the frontier passed from a loose military-protectorate arrangement to provincial rule, an arrangement that lasted into the twentieth century. Second came a lasting problem of borders and diplomacy. Russia took advantage of the demarcation of the Tongzhi years to acquire a wide area south of the Bulat River, and in 1871 again sent troops to occupy Ili on the pretext of Yaqub's attack on it; Ili was not recovered until Zeng Jize's negotiations in Moscow in 1881, and even then Russia kept part of the territory and the Qing court paid a compensation, so that the question of Ili became the source of fresh dispute in later decades. The rivalry of Britain and Russia over Kashgar was likewise fixed from this point, and Kashgar faced pressure from both at once. Third, the war updated the Qing military technology: the showing of rifled guns and muzzle-loading rifled rifles convinced the court of the value of foreign arms, the Jiangnan Arsenal, the Tianjin Arsenal and other modern works were established, and artillery regained a place in the order of battle. Fourth, northwest society was reshaped, as the amnesty and settlement policy after the war moved large numbers of displaced people back to farm the Hexi and Hetao plains, altering the distribution of communities and the local order of things; and the Taiping and Nian movements were destroyed in the course of these years, which turned the court's attention back inward.
result: 結果分三層。陝甘方面，回民起義的武裝在同治九年蘇家營一役崩解，馬化龍自盡，河州、肅州與關中各部在同治十年前後相繼被清軍攻破或接受招撫，陝甘重回清廷控制。反攻新疆方面，一八七一年清軍收復哈密、吐魯番、鄯善、焉耆、庫爾勒，把阿古柏逼回喀什噶爾與和闐；一八七六年劉錦棠部攻克達坂城、吐魯番並進入烏魯木齊，一八七七年南線在盆地南緣與羅布泊一帶擊潰阿古柏主力，阿古柏本人同年六月在喀什噶爾死去，餘部由其子率領退保和闐；一八七八年清軍進取喀什噶爾，一八七九年收復和田，南疆重歸中國。唯一未竟的是伊犁：俄軍自一八七一年佔領後，一八八〇年清廷命曾紀澤赴俄交涉，一八八一年訂約收回伊犁，但割地與賠款伴隨而來。戰役結束後，清廷以新疆建省與屯墾制度鞏固成果，這條線最終延續到二十世紀上半葉的邊疆治理格局。
resultEn: The outcome had three layers. In Shaanxi and Gansu the armed uprising collapsed in the action at Sujiaying in the ninth year of Tongzhi; Ma Hualong killed himself, and the bands of Hezhou, Suzhou and Guanzhong were broken by assault or taken on pardon in the years around the tenth year of Tongzhi, so that Shaanxi and Gansu returned to Qing control. On the counter-offensive into Xinjiang, in 1871 the Qing army recovered Hami, Turpan, Shanshan, Yanqi and Kucha, driving Yaqub back into Kashgar and Yarkand; in 1876 Liu Jintang's troops took Daban and Turpan and entered Urumqi, and in 1877 the southern column broke Yaqub's main force on the southern rim of the basin and near Lop Nor, while Yaqub himself died at Kashgar in June of that year, his remaining followers led by his son retreating to Yarkand; in 1878 the Qing advanced into Kashgar and in 1879 retook Yarkand, and the southern frontier returned to Chinese hands. Only Ili remained unfinished: after the Russian occupation of 1871 the court sent Zeng Jize to negotiate in 1880, and the treaty of 1881 restored Ili to China, but accompanied it with a cession of territory and an indemnity. In the aftermath the court consolidated the result through the establishment of the province of Xinjiang and a garrison-farm system, and that thread ran on into the frontier governance of the first half of the twentieth century.
